artworks.title: Huguet de Sémonville - Robert Macaire (Thiers) - Comte Roederer
artworks.description: The image features three full-body caricatures of men. The man on the left stands holding a handkerchief, wearing formal attire. The man in the center adjusts his coat, sporting a whimsical outfit. The man on the right is seated with a relaxed posture. The setting is a plain backdrop.

artworks.title: C.-A. Gabriel, duc de Choiseul
artworks.description: The image depicts a man standing. He is posed with one shoulder forward, looking to his left. His features are exaggerated in a caricature style, with a prominent chin and nose. He has short, combed-back hair and is dressed in a formal uniform with a badge on his chest. He holds a hat in his left hand and a cloth in his right hand. The background is plain with shading around his feet.

artworks.title: Gazan
artworks.description: The image shows a man sitting down with his legs slightly spread apart and his hands resting on his thighs. He is leaning forward with his head facing downward and has a stern facial expression. The man has exaggerated, cartoonish features, closely cropped hair, and is wearing a dark suit with a vest, coat, and trousers. His formal shoes are partially visible. The background is a textured gradient.

artworks.title: Napoléon Lannes
artworks.description: The image depicts a man sitting on a chair with his legs crossed and arms folded across his chest. His facial features include a prominent nose, a pointed chin, and closed eyes. His hair is neatly combed to the side. The man is wearing a formal outfit consisting of a buttoned-up jacket over a shirt, fitted trousers, and polished shoes. The background of the image is plain with light shading around the figure.

artworks.title: Le Ventre Législatif (The Legislative Belly)
artworks.description: The image shows a satirical drawing of a group of men in a legislative chamber. The men are depicted from the waist up, seated in several rows of benches. They have exaggerated facial features, varying hairstyles, and are dressed in 19th-century formal attire. Some hold papers. The scene is set in a semicircular hall with labeled rows, with figures in the background engaged in conversation or looking at documents.

artworks.title: Très hauts et très puissans moutards et moutardes légitimes
artworks.description: The image shows three figures and a seated child with exaggerated facial features. The central figure is a young person sitting upright on a rocking horse, wearing a dark, tailored outfit with a large ruffled collar and a crown on their head. They hold a sword in one hand. To the left is another child with long hair and a crown, wearing a dark coat with intricate embroidery over a light dress and boots. On the right is a child with curls, a crown, and a flowing gown, holding a doll. In front of them is a smaller person wearing a large hat and an outfit with a collar, kneeling and holding an object. The background is plain.

artworks.title: Ne vous y frottez pas!! (Don't You Meddle with It!!)
artworks.description: This is a drawing showing a central figure on a platform with "LIBERTE DE LA PRESSE" carved into it. The figure is muscular, standing confidently, looking to the side, and wearing plain clothing. To the left, two individuals in authoritarian uniforms and one civilian appear to be clashing with umbrellas. On the right, three figures are attending to a person in a uniform on the ground.

artworks.title: Enfoncé Lafayette!... Attrappe mon vieux!
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a figure in a hat and coat kneeling beside a grave. The background shows a textured landscape. Many onlookers and a distant gathering are visible. The scene includes a large figure in the foreground standing beside a cemetery marker with a cross. The landscape extends into the background, with small figures and vertical elements resembling trees or obelisks. The drawing is detailed in its rendering of the landscape and crowds.

artworks.title: Rue Transnonain, le 15 avril 1834
artworks.description: The image shows a man lying on his back on the floor. He appears unconscious or lifeless, with closed eyes and a slack jaw. He has short, dark hair and is wearing a light-colored nightshirt. His left hand is exposed, palm up. The background shows a dimly lit interior space with a bed frame and mattress visible behind him. Another indistinct figure lies in the shaded area at the back.

artworks.title: Amiral Verhuel
artworks.description: The image shows a full-body profile drawing of a person standing in a slightly bent posture. The person has pronounced facial features with a prominent brow, a noticeable nose, and heavy-lidded eyes. The hair is voluminous and swept back from the forehead. They are dressed in a dark jacket with wide lapels, buttoned up the front, light-colored pants, and decorative cuffs. One hand is resting on their chest while the other is bent at the elbow, appearing to hold an outturned hat on the side. The background is plain, with the figure casting a shadow on the surface.

artworks.title: Comte J.-Jérome Siméon
artworks.description: The image depicts a man sitting on a wooden chair, facing sideways. He is leaning slightly forward with his hands clasped over his stomach. The man is bald on the top of his head, wears spectacles, and has a pronounced nose and closed eyes. He is dressed in a dark, buttoned jacket with detailed sleeves and lapels, light-colored trousers, and dark shoes. The background is plain, emphasizing the figure. The drawing is done in a monochromatic style with shaded contours.

artworks.title: Baron de Lascours
artworks.description: Two figures are prominently shown in the image. The figure on the right is displayed from the waist up, seated in a profile position, turned slightly to the left. This person has a prominent aquiline nose, a broad forehead, and is balding with a bit of hair towards the back. He is dressed in a dark coat adorned with ornate embroidery or embellishments, including a large decoration on the chest. The figure on the left consists of three older men shown from the waist up, engaged in close conversation. They have distinct, exaggerated facial features such as pronounced noses and furrowed brows, and two of them have balding heads with the remaining hair towards the back. These men seem to be wearing simple, sketch-like clothing without significant details. In the foreground, there is a stack of papers on a desk-like surface. The background of the image is plain.

artworks.title: Viennet a la Tribune
artworks.description: The image shows a drawing of a man from the waist up. He is in a side profile, leaning forward with his right hand extended and left hand in his pocket. The man has prominent facial features, a jawline, high cheekbones, and dark, tousled hair. He wears a dark coat, a light-colored scarf, and is surrounded by papers or cards and a cylindrical object on the surface in front of him. The background is plain.

artworks.title: Les réjouissances de Juillet... vues de Ste. Pélagie
artworks.description: The image shows a group of eight people standing near a large window, with their full bodies visible. They are positioned with their backs to the viewer, all gazing out of the window. The individuals display a variety of facial profiles and some have visible facial features such as beards and strong noses, while their hair is hidden or obscured by hats and head coverings. The men are dressed in loose-fitting clothing, including shirts and pants, and some are wearing hats or caps. Outside the window, a hot air balloon can be seen floating in the sky, with numbers or text inscribed on it. The background shows a plain, bare wall inside what appears to be an interior space, centered around the window as the focal point of the composition.

artworks.title: Le Chevalier des Adrets est l'amant...
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a social scene. The image depicts a person seated at a table and another figure leaning over them. To the left, three figures are gathered, observing the scene. The setting is indoors with patterned flooring and a decorative screen in the background. The characters have exaggerated expressions and postures, suggesting a satirical style.

artworks.title: C'est tout de même flatteur d'avoir fait tant d'élèves!...
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a scene set on a busy street with several individuals engaged in conversation or movement. The composition features a variety of figures dressed in attire suggestive of the 19th century, including top hats and coats. The drawing captures the lively atmosphere of an urban setting, with people appearing to be engaged in social or business exchanges. Large signs in the background suggest commercial activity, with text indicating transactions or advertisements for stocks or capital investments. The expressions and postures of the individuals convey a sense of engagement or negotiation, and the style of the drawing employs detailed lines and exaggerated features.

artworks.title: L'Éducation au biberon
artworks.description: The image shows two individuals and a small doll-like figure sitting on a bed. The person in the middle has distinct facial features with sharp lines, a pointed nose, and slightly messy hair. The other individual, wearing a nightcap, has exaggerated facial features and an open-mouth expression. Both are dressed in nightshirts and are sitting closely together. The person in the middle holds the small figure, which has an oversized head compared to its body. The background is simple, with a handwritten signature and date in the lower right corner.

artworks.title: Oui Monsieur vous n'êtes pas de Paris...
artworks.description: The image shows two men standing from the waist up. The man on the left is leaning towards the other man, whose body is partially turned towards him. Both men wear dark, brimmed hats. The man on the left has a sharp nose and facial hair under his chin, wearing a coat with a high collar and holding an object behind his back. The man on the right looks surprised, with wide eyes and a furrowed brow. He is clean-shaven and wearing a jacket over a vest, with his hand near his neck. The background is plain.

artworks.title: Épicier citoyen, guerrier pur et sans tache...
artworks.description: This is a drawing depicting two characters in a store or market. The scene includes barrels, containers labeled 'RAISIN 17–17' and 'CORNED', cloths, a piece of meat, and a framed document. The characters exhibit exaggerated expressions and dynamic poses, adding a comedic tone to the scene. The use of shading and lines emphasizes the cartoonish style of the drawing.

artworks.title: L'Oeil du maitre
artworks.description: The image shows two individuals in an interior setting. The person on the right is standing in a three-quarter pose, facing slightly to the right, appearing to examine a glass close to their face. They have prominent facial features, a sharp nose, and a thoughtful expression. They are dressed in a white cap, a long white shirt, fitted pants, and slippers. The second individual, positioned towards the background on the left, is standing in profile while looking down at something they hold with both hands. They wear a long white garment and a dark cap. The background features drapery, a framed picture, and a small table with a glass display case holding an object.

artworks.title: Volé!... Rue vide-gousset...
artworks.description: The image shows a man standing with a slightly hunched posture, looking down at a parcel or letter in his hands. His facial features are sharp, with prominent eyes, a long nose, and a pronounced chin. He wears a top hat, a dark coat, tight pants, and shoes. The background features an urban street scene with a stone wall covered in posters on the left. People, some wearing top hats, can be seen walking on a cobblestone street lined with buildings.

artworks.title: C'est unique! j'ai pris quatre tailles...
artworks.description: This is an illustration of a person in front of a shop displaying corsets. The individual is wearing a tall hat and a long coat, standing with an umbrella tucked under their arm, looking at a shop window filled with various corsets. The shop window showcases an assortment of corsets, with the figure gazing in. The artwork features shading and fine lines for texture and depth, contrasting the dark attire of the person with the lighter corsets. The style is reminiscent of Honoré Daumier.

artworks.title: Le Barbillon entraine...
artworks.description: Two figures are depicted engaged in an activity by the water. The person on the left is standing on the rocky shore, leaning forward and pulling on a fishing pole. He has short, dark hair and is wearing rolled-up sleeves and striped pants. The person on the right is partially visible in the water, holding onto the fishing line. This individual has long dark hair and is wearing a wet, loose shirt. In the background, there are rocks and a tree along the water's edge, and a hat floating on the calm water. The image is set within a simple frame with a title and text at the bottom.

artworks.title: Le Barbillon entraine...
artworks.description: The image is a black and white drawing. It depicts two individuals, one on land and another in the water. The man on land is shown crouching on a ledge, leaning forward, pulling on a long branch. The person in the water is holding onto the branch with both hands and looking up at the man on the ledge. The man has short, wavy hair and is wearing a long-sleeved shirt, a vest, and striped pants. The person in the water has long, dark hair and is wearing a dark, long-sleeved garment. A hat is floating near this person. In the background, there is a tree-like structure and a basket on the ground. The image is labeled "LA PÊCHE" with handwritten notations below the drawing.
